question: How long the stage square takes to go out (and back) when the mouse comes onto the stage, by the row's Duration. Seen once: Duration 0.4s (Out) plays out in about 600 ms (CAP-T15STAGE3.json), held 500 ms, back in about 600 ms.

rules.A: a fixed 600 ms, whatever the Duration

scoring: a rule's guess holds when the time from the first frame that moves to the first frame within 0.5% of the peak, plus one frame, is within 15% of it
